descriptionChirho: A proper noun referring to Zoar (tso'ar, meaning 'small/insignificant'), one of the five cities of the plain where Lot took refuge during the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah (Gen 13:10; 14:2,8; 19:22,23,30; Deut 34:3; Isa 15:5; Jer 48:34). All three clusters are grammatical variants of the same toponym: bare/directional 'Zoar/to Zoar' (S130430), prepositional 'in Zoar/from Zoar' (S130431), and a further prepositional 'from Tsoar' (S130435). Multilingual evidence confirms a single geographic referent: 'तसोअर/सोअर' (hin), 'صُوعَرَ/صُوغَرَ' (arb), '소알/소아르' (kor), 'Soari' (swa), 'Zoar/Tzoar/Tsoar' (spa). Prepositions (be-, min-) are syntactic, not semantic.
